# 4a Router scripts module, schema, script versions: contract

**Read first:** [build README → Phase 4](./README.md#phase-4-router-scripts) (and its Phase 1–3 sections), [router scripts module](../modules/router-scripts.md), [script versions](../processes/router-scripts/script-versions.md), [ADR 0011](../adr/0011-router-script-parameters-from-local-block.md), [ADR 0010](../adr/0010-router-contract-stays-mtvpn-compatible.md), [data model → Router scripts](../data-model.md#router-scripts), today's script in `internal/modules/routerscripts/params/paramstest/fresh-router.rsc`, designs `RP-Scripts` and `RP-Script`, and the **As built** of 1b (template drafts with revisions, the stale band, the publish page, versions, diff, the editor bundle), 3d (`initCodeAreas`, the single CodeMirror field with its own mode) and 2a (module wiring, `TestImportsOnlyServersPorts`).

**Done when:** the `routerscripts` module is enabled after `routing` and migrates the whole Phase 4 schema; router scripts can be created from a pasted or uploaded body; the draft is edited in CodeMirror with RouterOS highlighting beside a panel of detected parameters, computed values and problems that follows the text; it is saved with stale-tab protection and published (errors block, warnings need a tick, notes) as the next and current version; versions can be viewed, diffed (any two, and the draft), downloaded unfilled byte for byte and made current; scripts can be renamed, archived and deleted (only without generations); `params` detects, checks and fills exactly as ADR 0011 and the process doc say, on today's real `fresh-router.rsc`; every checklist line has its test.

No generations in 4a: their tables exist (written ahead) and every count of generations reads them, so it works unchanged once 4b exists.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Module | Name `routerscripts`. `routerscripts.New(p Ports) *Module`. In 4a it implements `Module`, `Initializer`, `EventDeclarer`, `MessagesDeclarer`, `RouteDeclarer`, `NavDeclarer`, `SubjectNamer`, `Searcher`. Later: `JobDeclarer` and `NotificationRenderer` (4c). `Init` builds `Scripts` (and `Generations` from 4b) with `Now: func() time.Time { return m.Now() }`. `Ports` is empty in 4a; 4b adds `Links` and `Routers`. | Build README → Phase 4 layout. |
| Wiring | `cmd/proxier/main.go`: `rs := routerscripts.New(routerscripts.Ports{})`, returned after `rt`. | The ports come in 4b. |
| Imports | `TestImportsOnlyPorts` parses every non-test `.go` file under the module (`go/parser`, `ImportsOnly`) and fails on any import of `internal/modules/servers/…`, and of `internal/modules/subscriptions/…` or `internal/modules/routing/…` other than those two root packages. In 4a the module imports none of them. | Build README rule "Ports only". |
| Fixture | `params/paramstest` embeds today's `fresh-router.rsc` (byte for byte from `~/projects/mikrotik` at `b1e34f2`: 351 lines, LF, no `\r`, `subUrl` already the placeholder `https://files....t`) and builds variants in code: `WithEnd(b)` inserts `# END PARAMETERS` on the line after `:local dohForwarder`, `Annotate(b, name, comment)` inserts a comment line directly above `:local <name>`, `Replace(b, old, new)`. Nobody edits the file; a later change of the real script is copied in as a new fixture, not merged into this one. | The process doc's edge cases are about today's file; the user pointed at it. |
| The block | `params.Parse(body)` reads the body as lines split after `\n`; a line's `\r\n` or `\n` is its terminator, ignored when matching and kept when writing. The block starts at the first line that is `#`, optional spaces, `PARAMETERS`, optional spaces (case-sensitive: `#   1. Edit the PARAMETERS section below.` isn't one). It ends at the first later line `# END PARAMETERS` (the same spacing rule), or, without one, just before the first line that is neither blank, a comment (`#` after optional spaces) nor a `:local` line (`:local` after optional spaces), which is a warning. Inside an ended block, a line that is none of those is a warning ("line 31 inside the PARAMETERS block is neither a comment nor a :local line"); a second `# PARAMETERS` line before the end is an error; an `# END PARAMETERS` line with no block before it is a warning. | script-versions.md; ADR 0011. |
| Script parameters | Inside the block, a `:local <name> <rest>` line with a name `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` and `<rest>` (trimmed) exactly one literal is a script parameter: a **quoted** literal (`"` … `"` with RouterOS escapes `\" \\ \$ \? \n \r \t \_ \a \b \f \v` and `\XX` hex, nothing after the closing quote) or a **bare** one (`[A-Za-z0-9._:/+-]+`, e.g. `7024005`, `true`, `ether1`). Its default is the literal's value with the escapes resolved. A quoted literal with an escape RouterOS doesn't know, or a `:local` line whose name can't be read, is an error ("line 40: can't read this :local line"). | ADR 0011; edge case `:local retries 3`. |
| Computed values | A `:local` line in the block whose `<rest>` isn't one literal (an expression, `[command]`, `$name`, a literal followed by more, or nothing) is a **computed value**: shown read-only with its expression. `params.Eval` gives the value of the ones made only of a parenthesised concatenation (`.`) of quoted strings and `$names` set earlier in the block, or a bare `$name`, from the current values; the others have none. With the defaults, `vpnGateway` = `($containerNet . ".2")` = `192.168.89.2`. | modules/router-scripts.md "shown read-only, so the admin can see what it derives from"; RP-Script-generate shows the value. |
| Descriptions | The comment lines directly above a `:local` line (no blank line in between), with `#` and one following space stripped, the annotation lines and the `# PARAMETERS` line itself left out, joined with a space. | script-versions.md; edge case "only the comment line directly above `lanIface`". |
| Annotations | A comment line of the block whose text starts with `@`. Known: `@secret`, `@required` (both alone on the line), `@choices a\|b\|c` (split on `\|`, trimmed: at least one, none empty, no duplicates), `@pattern <regex>` (Go RE2, matched against the whole value as `^(?:<regex>)$`), `@fill <kind>` with kinds `subscription-link`, `routing-address-list`, `routing-doh-forwarder`, `proxier-ssh-key`. **Errors**: an unknown name (`@fil` → "unknown annotation @fil"); a malformed one (text after `@secret`/`@required`, no or empty choices, a pattern that doesn't compile, `@fill` without a kind or with an unknown one); the same annotation twice on one parameter; one `@fill` kind on two parameters; `@fill` on a bare literal (fills are strings); `@fill` with `@choices`; a non-empty default that isn't one of its `@choices`. **Warnings**: annotations directly above a computed value (nothing to fill); annotations followed by a blank line or the end marker (they belong to no parameter); a non-empty default that doesn't match its `@pattern`. Annotation lines outside the block are ordinary comments. | modules/router-scripts.md (the table) + `@required` and `@fill proxier-ssh-key` (the design's RP-Script; the zero-touch decision). |
| Groups | Blank lines split the block into groups of parameters and computed values, in order. When the only description in a group belongs to its first item, the form and the panel show it as the group's **heading** ("interface names" over `lanIface`, `containerIface`, `vethName`; "container internal /24 …" over `containerNet` and `vpnGateway`); otherwise each description is shown with its own item (`lanNet`, `wanIface`, `subUrl`). Presentation only: the description still belongs to that parameter. | RP-Script-generate's groups; the process doc's edge case still holds. |
| Findings | `params.Finding{Line, Severity, Key, Args}`; the keys are i18n keys under `params.` and `params.Messages()` holds their EN/RU texts (the root merges them, as subscriptions merges `output.Messages`). Errors block publishing; warnings need the tick. The body's own findings come from `Parse`; at publish, `params.Gone(base, n, s)` adds a warning per parameter of the version the draft is based on that is no longer there ("vethName was in v3 and is gone here"). Without an end marker the warning names where the block stopped and the last three names read ("The PARAMETERS block has no # END PARAMETERS line, so it ends at line 66; the last values read are minVer, ver, v."). | script-versions.md step 3. |
| Literals | `params.Literal(p, value)`: for a quoted parameter, `"` + the value with `\` → `\\`, `"` → `\"`, `$` → `\$`, `?` → `\?` + `"`; for a bare one, the value as it is, which must itself be a bare literal (`params.err.bare`: "must be one word like the default, e.g. 8"). Any control character (below U+0020, and U+007F) or invalid UTF-8 is refused (`params.err.control`). `a"b$c` → `"a\"b\$c"`. `?` is escaped although `/import` would take it, because `\?` is always a valid escape and a pasted line never prompts for help. | script-generation.md step 6.3. |
| Checking a value | `params.Check(p, value)` (after trimming): `@required` and empty → `params.err.required`; `@choices` and not one of them → `params.err.choice`; `@pattern` and no match → `params.err.pattern`; else `Literal`'s error, or none. 4b checks every field with it. | script-generation.md step 5. |
| Filling | `params.Fill(body, values)` parses the body and, for each parameter whose value differs from its default, replaces only that literal's bytes on its line with `Literal(p, value)`; every other byte, line terminators included, is copied. A name that isn't a parameter is an error (`params.ErrUnknown`); a missing name keeps its default. With all defaults the output equals the body. | "Only parameter literals are changed. A generated file is byte-identical to its version everywhere else." |
| Scripts | Name: trimmed, 1–60 characters, unique (exact match). Slug: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$`, unique; **New script** suggests it from the name (lower case, a trailing `.rsc` dropped, every run of other characters → `-`, trimmed: "fresh-router.rsc" → `fresh-router`); it is fixed once a version exists (file names use it, as templates'). Description ≤ 500. Body: valid UTF-8, no NUL, 1 byte – 512 KiB (`scripts.err.body_empty`, `…_binary`, `…_large`). Errors are `store.FieldErrors` (field → i18n key) and nothing is written. | Templates' rules (1a, 1b); today's script is 20 KB. |
| New script | `GET /router-scripts/new` (a page styled as a dialog): name, slug (placeholder: the suggestion), description, the body pasted into a text area or a `.rsc` file (an uploaded file wins). `POST /router-scripts` (multipart): the script and its draft (`based_on` none, revision 1) in one `Write`, a pasted body with LF line endings (browsers send CRLF), an uploaded one byte for byte; `routerscript.created{name}`; then the script page. The design's separate **Import…** isn't built: this is it. | script-versions.md step 1. |
| Draft | At most one per script (`rscripts_drafts`, `revision` from 1). **Edit** makes one from the current version (`based_on` = its number); with a draft already there it opens that one. **Save draft** posts `body` + `revision` (+ an optional `file`, which replaces the body): another save in between → `scripts.ErrDraftChanged`; the same body → nothing recorded, the revision kept; else revision + 1 and `routerscript.draft_saved{based_on}`. **Discard draft…** (strength 1, "The draft is dropped; v4 stays current.") deletes it with `routerscript.draft_discarded{based_on}`; it is offered only when the script has a version (a script with none would be left with nothing: delete it instead). | script-versions.md step 4; 1b's revisions. |
| Line endings | Browsers send a text area with CRLF. The server gives the posted text the line endings of the body it replaces (CRLF when that body's first line ends with `\r\n`, else LF), so saving from the editor never changes every line of an LF or a CRLF script. An uploaded file is kept byte for byte. The text area is written with one leading newline (HTML drops the first newline after `<textarea>`), so a body that starts with a blank line survives the round trip. | Byte for byte; 1b turned CRLF into LF for templates. |
| Editor | The **Draft** area is a form posting to `/router-scripts/:id/draft` with a `textarea[data-code="routeros"]` named `body` (works without JS) and the hidden `revision`. The editor bundle puts CodeMirror on it (`initCodeAreas`, 3d) with the new `routeros` mode; `⌘S` submits **Save draft**. The text area carries `hx-post="/router-scripts/:id/draft/parameters" hx-trigger="input changed delay:400ms" hx-target="#params-panel" hx-swap="outerHTML"`, and the bundle fires `input` on it when CodeMirror's text changes (debounced 300 ms), so the panel follows the text; without JS it follows the text area directly. The panel answer records nothing. | RP-Script "Detected parameters · updates as you type". |
| Panel | `#params-panel` (RP-Script's aside): "Detected parameters · 18", then per group its heading and items: a parameter's name, default (`"10.230.1"` as written; `•••` for `@secret`), annotations (`@fill subscription-link`), description; a computed value's name, `= ($containerNet . ".2")` and `→ 192.168.89.2` when `Eval` has a value; then the problems (line, severity marker, text) and, against the base version, the gone parameters ("wifiCountry was in v4 and is gone here"). Without a block: "No PARAMETERS block: the script is versioned and downloadable, with nothing to fill in." Its problem rows carry `data-code-finding data-line data-sev data-msg` and the panel `data-code-findings="draft-body"`; the bundle turns them into CodeMirror lint markers after every swap. `]d [d` are not built. | RP-Script; 1b's lint markers. |
| Stale draft | A save whose revision isn't the draft's answers 409 with the band "The draft changed since you opened it (another tab saved it)." and **Reload** (the saved draft); the posted text stays in the editor, **Save draft** and **Publish** are off, so nothing typed is lost (copy it out, reload, paste). | 1b's band. |
| Publish | **Publish v5…** submits the editor with `next=publish` (saved first when it changed), then `GET /router-scripts/:id/publish`, a page styled as a dialog: the report (errors with their lines and texts, then warnings), notes (≤ 500), a tick "Publish with these warnings" when there are warnings, and what happens ("v5 becomes the current version. New generations use it; the 3 generations made so far keep their versions."). `POST` with `revision`: errors → 422, nothing written; warnings without the tick → 422; a stale revision → 409; else one `Write`: version N + 1 (the body byte for byte, its SHA-256, the confirmed warnings as JSON, notes, published at and by), `current_version` = N + 1, the draft deleted, `routerscript.version_published{version, parameters, warnings}` (counts). Then the script page with "Published v5." The first publish makes v1 current and fixes the slug. | script-versions.md step 3. |
| Versions | The script page lists versions newest first: number ("v4 · current"), published (day, by), notes, generations made from it; **View**, **Diff**, **Download**, and **Make current** on the others. **Make current** (strength 1, "New generations use v3. v4 stays in the list."): `current_version` = 3 and `routerscript.current_changed{from, to}`; making the current one current again changes nothing. Versions are never deleted, so numbers have no gaps. | script-versions.md "Steps — versions". |
| Version page | `GET /router-scripts/:id/versions/:n`: the body read-only and highlighted (`ui.Code` with `ui.Highlight("<slug>.rsc", body)`), the warnings confirmed at publish under their lines, the version's detected parameters and computed values as the panel shows them (with their groups), **Download**, **Diff with…** (a select, default the previous version), **Make current**, and (4b) **Generate from this version**. | ui/README "View". |
| Diff | `GET /router-scripts/:id/diff?from=<n\|draft>&to=<n\|draft>`: unified, or side by side with `view=split`, through `go-udiff` and `ui.Diff` (as templates). Defaults: the draft against its base when there is a draft, else the current version against the one before it. Two equal bodies say so. | "Diff (any two)". |
| Download | `GET /router-scripts/:id/versions/:n/download`: the body byte for byte, `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<slug>-v<n>.rsc"`, `Cache-Control: no-store`. An admin route (a version holds whatever the admin pasted, defaults included). | "Any version can be downloaded unfilled, exactly as written." |
| Details | **Edit details** (a page styled as a dialog): name, slug (read-only once a version exists), description. A change records `routerscript.changed{fields}` (`name, slug, description`); no change records nothing. | |
| Archive, delete | **Archive** hides the script from the list (behind "Show archived (1)") and from search, and turns **Generate** off (4b); **Unarchive** brings it back; `routerscript.archived{archived}`. **Delete…** (a page styled as a dialog, type the slug) only while no generation was made from it: the script, its versions and its draft go, `routerscript.deleted{name}`; with generations the page says "3 generations were made from fresh-router; archive it instead" and the button is off (`scripts.ErrHasGenerations`, 409). | script-versions.md rules; templates' delete. |
| List | `/router-scripts` (`RP-Scripts`): the title block with the explanation ("RouterOS scripts that set up a fresh MikroTik. Each one filled in for a router is a generation.") and **New script** (key `n`). Rows (`data-row`, `data-href`): the name with its description under it; current ("v4", or "no version yet"); published (the current version's day); generations ("3"; 4b adds "· 1 awaiting setup"); draft ("draft · 18 parameters", "draft · 2 problems", or "no draft"). Empty state: what a router script is, and **New script**. | `RP-Scripts`. |
| Script page | Crumbs (Router scripts / name), the name, the status line ("current v4 · draft based on v4 · 3 generations"; "no version yet · draft"), title block buttons: **Generate for a new router** (4b; not shown in 4a), **Save draft** and **Publish v5…** (with a draft), **Edit** (without one). Areas in DOM order: **Draft** (the editor and the panel side by side; one column under 760 px; without a draft: "No draft. Edit makes one from v4, the current version."), **Versions**, **Generations** (4b; 4a shows "None yet."), **Actions** (Edit details, Discard draft…, Archive / Unarchive, Delete…), **Activity** (the last 10 events of `router_script:<id>`). | `RP-Script`; Phase 2's Actions area instead of "More ▾". |
| Highlighting | `ui.LangFor` maps `.rsc` to `routeros`, a chroma `RegexLexer` the `ui` package registers, with tokens chosen so the colours are RP-Script's: a comment line (`#` after spaces) is `CommentSingle` (subtle italic), and one whose text starts with `@` is `CommentSpecial`, which `app.css` now colours iris (`.hl .cs`; no other lexer of ours emits it); `:local` and every other `:command` are `NameAttribute` (foam italic); `"…"` with backslash escapes is `LiteralString` (gold); `$name` and `$"name"` are `NameVariable` (rose); numbers `LiteralNumber`; a `/word …` menu path at the start of a statement `NameBuiltin`; `= [ ] ( ) { } ; .` `Punctuation`; everything else `Text`. The editor bundle's `routeros` StreamLanguage mode gives the same colours through its theme's tags (`comment`; `keyword` for annotations; `propertyName` for `:commands`; `string`; `variableName`; `number`; `atom` for menu paths). | ui/README "Code editor: … RouterOS script"; RP-Script's colours. |
| Events | Declare every Phase 4 type now (table below), `Module: "routerscripts"`; each has `event.<type>`, the notifying one `notify.<type>` and `.body`. Recorded in 4a: `created`, `changed`, `draft_saved`, `draft_discarded`, `version_published`, `current_changed`, `archived`, `deleted`. | 1a's pattern. |
| Nav, search, names | Nav: group `routerscripts`, **Scripts** `/router-scripts`, order 10, no go-to key. Search: scripts that aren't archived, by name or slug: label = name, meta "router script · v4 · 3 generations", href = the page; actions: **New script**. `SubjectNamer`: `router_script` → name, `/router-scripts/<id>` (a deleted one: its name from the event payload is enough, so an unknown id gives no reference); `generation` arrives in 4b. | ui/README search "router scripts". |

## Tables

`internal/modules/routerscripts/migrations/00001_routerscripts.sql`: every Phase 4 table. Times are `db.Time` text. Ids of other modules' things are plain integers (ADR 0002).

```sql
-- +goose Up

CREATE TABLE rscripts_scripts (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name            TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    slug            TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    current_version INTEGER,                                    -- NULL until the first publish
    archived        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (archived IN (0,1)),
    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (id, current_version) REFERENCES rscripts_versions(script_id, number) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
) STRICT;

-- Immutable, numbered without gaps. The body is stored byte for byte and
-- parsed on demand; only the warnings confirmed at publish are kept.
CREATE TABLE rscripts_versions (
    script_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rscripts_scripts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    number       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (number >= 1),
    body         TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256       TEXT NOT NULL,                                 -- hex of the body
    warnings     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',                    -- JSON params.Finding list confirmed at publish
    notes        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    published_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    published_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (script_id, number)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE rscripts_drafts (
    script_id  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES rscripts_scripts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    body       TEXT NOT NULL,
    based_on   INTEGER,                                         -- the version it was made from; NULL for a new script
    revision   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_by TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- A version filled in for one router (4b). The file itself is never stored:
-- it is params.Fill(the version's body, the values) when it is downloaded or
-- fetched. A script with generations can't be deleted (the version reference
-- refuses the cascade).
CREATE TABLE rscripts_generations (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    script_id         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version           INTEGER NOT NULL,
    router_name       TEXT NOT NULL,                            -- as entered; names the file and, when registered, the router
    file_name         TEXT NOT NULL,                            -- "<slug>-<router>-v<n>.rsc"
    vals              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',               -- JSON {name: value} of every parameter that isn't secret
    secrets           BLOB,                                     -- vault "generation:<id>:secrets": JSON {name: value} of the @secret ones and the link's URL; NULL when none
    changed           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',                 -- parameters whose value differs from the default, comma-joined, in script order
    link_id           INTEGER,                                  -- subscriptions' link, by value; NULL when none was used
    link_name         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    link_created      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (link_created IN (0,1)),
    router_id         INTEGER,                                  -- routing's router, by value; NULL when not registered
    router_registered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (router_registered IN (0,1)),
    key_fingerprint   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',                 -- Proxier's key a @fill proxier-ssh-key parameter got
    created_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by        TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (script_id, version) REFERENCES rscripts_versions(script_id, number),
    CHECK (link_created = 0 OR link_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (router_registered = 0 OR router_id IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX rscripts_generations_script ON rscripts_generations(script_id, id);

-- A generation's single-use, short-lived URL (4c). The token is erased the
-- moment the URL ends.
CREATE TABLE rscripts_fetch_urls (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    generation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rscripts_generations(id),
    token         BLOB,                                         -- vault "fetch_url:<id>:token"; NULL once the URL ended
    token_lookup  BLOB UNIQUE,                                  -- vault.Lookup(token); NULL with the token
    state         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('waiting','used','expired','replaced')),
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by    TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at      TEXT,                                         -- used, replaced, or found expired
    ip            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',                     -- of the fetch that used it
    user_agent    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',                     -- at most 256 characters
    CHECK ((token IS NULL) = (token_lookup IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((state = 'waiting') = (token IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((state = 'waiting') = (ended_at IS NULL))
) STRICT;
-- At most one live fetch URL per generation.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rscripts_fetch_urls_waiting ON rscripts_fetch_urls(generation_id) WHERE state = 'waiting';
CREATE INDEX rscripts_fetch_urls_generation ON rscripts_fetch_urls(generation_id, id);

-- +goose Down
DROP TABLE rscripts_fetch_urls;
DROP TABLE rscripts_generations;
DROP TABLE rscripts_drafts;
DROP TABLE rscripts_versions;
DROP TABLE rscripts_scripts;
```

Publishing inserts the version before it points `current_version` at it (the reference is deferred, so the order inside the transaction doesn't matter). A fetch URL is inserted with `token = X''` and its lookup, then the token is sealed with the new id in the same transaction (links' pattern); the checks hold throughout.

## Go signatures

### `routerscripts` (root)

```go
// Ports are what the module uses of other modules (4b). A nil one hides its features.
type Ports struct{}

type Module struct {
	Now     func() time.Time // the module's clock; tests replace it
	Scripts *scripts.Service
	// Generations: 4b
}
func New(p Ports) *Module
```

### `routerscripts/params`

```go
const (
	Error   = "error"
	Warning = "warning"
)

// The @fill kinds.
const (
	FillLink      = "subscription-link"
	FillList      = "routing-address-list"
	FillForwarder = "routing-doh-forwarder"
	FillKey       = "proxier-ssh-key"
)

var ErrUnknown = errors.New("params: not a parameter of the script")

type Annotations struct {
	Secret   bool
	Required bool
	Choices  []string
	Pattern  string // as written
	Fill     string // a Fill kind or ""
}

type Param struct {
	Name        string
	Line        int    // 1-based
	Default     string // the literal's value, escapes resolved
	Literal     string // as written: `"10.230.1"`, `7024005`
	Bare        bool
	Description string
	Annotations Annotations
}

type Computed struct {
	Name        string
	Line        int
	Expr        string // as written after the name; "" for none
	Description string
}

// Item is one parameter or computed value, in script order.
type Item struct {
	Param    *Param
	Computed *Computed
}

type Group struct {
	Heading string // the group's only description, when it belongs to its first item
	Items   []Item
}

type Finding struct {
	Line     int
	Severity string         // Error, Warning
	Key      string         // "params.err.duplicate", …
	Args     map[string]any // name, annotation, line, names, version
}

type Script struct {
	Block    bool // a PARAMETERS line exists
	Start    int  // its line; 0 without one
	End      int  // the end marker's line, or the last line read without one
	Ended    bool // closed by # END PARAMETERS
	Params   []Param
	Computed []Computed
	Groups   []Group
	Findings []Finding // what the body alone shows, by line
}

func Parse(body []byte) Script
func (s Script) Param(name string) (Param, bool)
func (s Script) Errors() []Finding
func (s Script) Warnings() []Finding
// Gone: a warning per parameter of base (version n) that s doesn't have.
func Gone(base Script, n int, s Script) []Finding
// Literal writes value as p's RouterOS literal (errors: params.err.control, params.err.bare).
func Literal(p Param, value string) (string, error)
// Check validates a value for p; the i18n key of the problem, or "".
func Check(p Param, value string) string
// Fill rewrites the literals of the parameters whose value differs from the default.
func Fill(body []byte, values map[string]string) ([]byte, error)
// Eval gives the computed values it can: concatenations of strings and earlier names.
func Eval(s Script, values map[string]string) map[string]string
// Changed lists, in script order, the parameters whose value differs from the default.
func Changed(s Script, values map[string]string) []string
// Values is every parameter's default.
func (s Script) Values() map[string]string
func Messages() i18n.Messages
```

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /router-scripts` | List (`?archived=1` shows the archived ones) |
| `GET /router-scripts/new`, `POST /router-scripts` | New script (multipart: `name`, `slug`, `description`, `body` or `file`) → the script page |
| `GET /router-scripts/:id` | The script page |
| `GET /router-scripts/:id/details`, `POST /router-scripts/:id/details` | Edit details |
| `POST /router-scripts/:id/edit` | Make (or open) the draft from the current version |
| `POST /router-scripts/:id/draft` | Save draft (`body`, `revision`, optional `file`, `next=publish`) |
| `POST /router-scripts/:id/draft/parameters` | The panel for the posted `body` (htmx; records nothing) |
| `POST /router-scripts/:id/draft/discard` | Discard draft (strength 1) |
| `GET /router-scripts/:id/publish`, `POST /router-scripts/:id/publish` | Publish (`revision`, `notes`, `confirm`) |
| `GET /router-scripts/:id/versions/:n` | Version page |
| `GET /router-scripts/:id/versions/:n/download` | The body unfilled |
| `POST /router-scripts/:id/versions/:n/current` | Make current (strength 1) |
| `GET /router-scripts/:id/diff` | `from`, `to` (numbers or `draft`), `view=split` |
| `POST /router-scripts/:id/archive`, `POST /router-scripts/:id/unarchive` | Archive, unarchive |
| `GET /router-scripts/:id/delete`, `POST /router-scripts/:id/delete` | Delete (type the slug) |

## Events

Declare every Phase 4 type now (`Module: "routerscripts"`). Subjects: `router_script:<id>`, `generation:<id>`.

| Type | Notify | Emoji | Subject | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `routerscript.created` | off | | router script | `name` |
| `routerscript.changed` | off | | router script | `fields`: of `name, slug, description` — **new** |
| `routerscript.draft_saved` | off | | router script | `based_on` (the version number, `0` for none) — **new** |
| `routerscript.draft_discarded` | off | | router script | `based_on` — **new** |
| `routerscript.version_published` | off | | router script | `version`, `parameters` (count), `warnings` (count) |
| `routerscript.current_changed` | off | | router script | `from`, `to` (numbers) — **new** |
| `routerscript.archived` | off | | router script | `archived` (bool) — **new** |
| `routerscript.deleted` | off | | router script | `name` — **new** |
| `routerscript.generated` | off | | generation | `script`, `version`, `router`, `link` (names, `""` for none), `registered`, `link_created` (bools) (4b) |
| `routerscript.fetch_url_created` | off | | generation | `expires`, `replaced` (bool) (4c) |
| `routerscript.fetched` | **on** | 📥 | generation | `ip`, `user_agent` (4c) |
| `routerscript.fetch_url_expired` | off | | generation | `expired` (the expiry time) (4c) |

## Pages

- **Scripts** (`RP-Scripts`): as in Decisions → List. Archived scripts behind "Show archived (N)".
- **New script**: a page styled as a dialog (Decisions → New script).
- **Script** (`RP-Script`): as in Decisions → Script page. Desktop: the editor takes about two thirds, the panel the rest; the Versions and Generations areas sit side by side below. Phone: one column, the panel under the editor, buttons full width.
- **Publish**, **Edit details**, **Delete**: pages styled as dialogs.
- **Version**, **Diff**: read-only pages (Decisions).

## As built

Built 2026-10-09. Every checklist line has its test of that name in that file; `make check` (with `check-editor`), `make lint` (0 issues) and `docker build .` are green. Every package of the module runs under `-race`.

**Packages** as in Files. `params` is pure (`params.go`, `parse.go`, `annotations.go`, `groups.go`, `literal.go`, `fill.go`, `eval.go`, `messages.go`); `params/paramstest` embeds the real `fresh-router.rsc` (committed with the contracts, untouched). The root merges `params.Messages()` into its catalog.

**Deviations and additions** (the contract's signatures otherwise hold):

- `params`: `FillKinds`, `ErrControl` / `ErrBare` (Literal's errors; their texts are the i18n keys, so `Check` returns `err.Error()`), `Item.Name()` / `Item.Description()`, JSON tags on `Finding` (versions store them). `Param` keeps the literal's byte offset unexported (Fill uses it). The `\XX` escape takes capital hex digits only (RouterOS's rule), so `\a`, `\b`, `\f` stay the named escapes. A duplicate `:local` (parameter or computed) is an error on the later line and only the first is kept. The no-end warning sits on the block's last line (`End`); the no-block warning and the gone-parameter warnings have line 0. A code line inside an ended block, and a second `# PARAMETERS` line, end the description run above (they don't split groups; only blank lines do). An empty value passes `@choices` and `@pattern` unless `@required` (then `Literal`'s rule applies: a bare parameter still refuses it).
- `scripts`: `Normalize`, `ReportFor(ctx, id, body, basedOn)` (the panel, nothing saved), `Body(ctx, id, ref)` and `DraftRef` (`"draft"`), `Generations(ctx, id)`, the limits `MaxName`, `MaxDescription`, `MaxNotes`, `MaxBody`; `*PublishError` implements `error`. `Diff` returns `""` for equal bodies (the page says "The two are the same."). `List(ctx, true)` lists the archived ones only (the list's "Show archived (N)" chip). **Edit** making a draft from the current version records `routerscript.draft_saved{based_on}` (every state change records an event). Edit details: an empty slug before the first version takes the suggestion; after it, an empty or unchanged slug is kept and another one is `scripts.err.slug_fixed`. `ErrArchived` is declared for 4b (Generate refuses an archived script); nothing in 4a returns it.
- `store`: `Taken(ctx, q, column, value, except)`, `PublishedAt`, `Drafts`, `GenerationCounts`, `VersionGenerations`, `Generations`, `LastVersion`; NULL `current_version` / `based_on` read as 0.
- `rscriptstest.Harness.Publish(id, body)` (Edit + save + publish with the tick) besides `Script`.
- Pages: action ids are `rs.*` (the message-key test treats every `rscripts.…` / `scripts.…` literal as a key, as 1b did with `tpl.*`). The title block's **Save draft** and **Publish vN…** are submit buttons outside the form (`form="draft-form"`); Save carries `data-code-save`, which the bundle's `⌘S` presses. **Discard draft…** on a script with no version answers 409 (it isn't offered). The delete page with generations offers **Archive** under the form. The script page loads `js/editor.bundle.js` only with a draft.
- Editor bundle: besides the contract's `routeros` mode, input events and lint rows, the editor theme got `minWidth: 0`: in the code area's flex host CodeMirror otherwise grew to its longest line and widened the whole page at phone width (also true of 3d's Shadowrocket field before).
- `ui`: the `routeros` lexer is registered in `init` (`internal/platform/ui/routeros.go`); numbers come out as `LiteralNumber` (`.m`), escapes as `LiteralStringEscape` (`.se`, gold like strings). `app.css` colours `.hl .cs` iris and has the module's classes (`.row.rscript`, `.rs-editor`, `.rs-panel`, `.rs-group`, `.rs-item`, `.rs-problems`, `.row.rsver`, …).

**Checked in a real browser** (the `chromedp/headless-shell:156.0.8078.12` container over CDP, a throwaway server on the host, nothing committed): the draft page of today's script with the end marker: RouterOS colours in CodeMirror (`:local` foam italic, strings gold, comments subtle italic, `$variables` rose); typing a second `:local lanNet` updated the panel ("Duplicate parameter lanNet." on line 27) and put an error lint marker on the line; `Ctrl+S` (the container is Linux, so CodeMirror's `Mod` is Ctrl) saved (`?saved=1`, revision 2); a save after another tab's save showed the stale band with the typed text kept and Save/Publish off; at 390 px one column, the panel under the editor, no horizontal scroll (after the `minWidth` fix); the version page highlighted. No CSP violation or script error (the only console line was the expected 409 of the stale save and Chrome's note that COOP is ignored over plain http).

**Facts 4b relies on.**

- `Ports` is empty; `main.go` wires `routerscripts.New(routerscripts.Ports{})` after routing. The Generations area of the script page says "None yet."; the list's and versions' generation counts and `Delete`'s refusal already read `rscripts_generations`.
- `params.Check(p, value)` checks a field; `params.Fill(body, values)` makes the file; `params.Changed` gives the `changed` column; `params.Eval` the computed values for the form; `Script.Groups` (with headings) is the form's layout. A secret default is shown as `•••` in the panel (`Annotations.Secret`).
- `scripts.Service.Version(ctx, id, 0)` is the current version; `Script.Archived` should refuse Generate (`ErrArchived`).
- Event `routerscript.fetched` already has `notify.routerscript.fetched` (+ `.body`) texts; its renderer is 4c's.

**Not done / the user's.** Nothing of the checklist; the browser check above was on a throwaway server, so a look at the deployed instance (and the phone in a real browser) is the user's. No real router has imported a version.
